Restricted Share Incentive Schemes
The following is a summary of the principal terms of the 2023 Restricted Share
IncentiveSchemeapprovedbytheShareholdersonAugust31,2023and2025RestrictedShare
Incentive Scheme of our Company approved by the Shareholders on May 28, 2025
(collectively, the “Restricted Share Incentive Schemes” or the “Schemes”). The terms of the
Restricted Share Incentive Schemes are not subject to the provisions of Chapter 17 of the
Listing Rules as they do not involve any grant of awards by our Company after our Listing.
Save as otherwise disclosed, the terms of the Restricted Share Incentive Schemes are
substantially similar and are summarized below.
(i) Purpose
The purpose of the Restricted Share Incentive Schemes is to improve our Group’s
corporate governance structure and establish a long-term incentive and restraint mechanism,
– VI-17 –

=== PAGE 462 ===
APPENDIX VI STATUTORY AND GENERAL INFORMATION
attract and retain outstanding talent, and fully motivate their initiative and creativity. The
Schemesareimplementedtoeffectivelystrengthenthecohesionof ourcoreteamandenhance
our Company’s core competitiveness and to support the achievement of our Company’s
strategic and operational goals while safeguarding the interests of Shareholders.
(ii) Administration
The Restricted Share Incentive Schemes are executed by the Board subject to the
authorization by the Shareholders. The Remuneration and Evaluation Committee is
responsibleforformulatingandrevisingthetermsof theRestrictedShareIncentiveSchemes,
which shall be submitted to the Board for consideration and approval.
(iii) Eligibility and Participation
Participantsof the2023RestrictedShareIncentiveSchemewillconsistof management
and key employees of our Group. Participants of the 2025 Restricted Share Incentive Scheme
will consist of Directors (excludes independent non-executive Directors), management and
key employees of our Group, as the Board determines from time to time to receive awards
under the Schemes.
(iv) Source and Maximum Number of Shares
The Shares underlying the 2023 Restricted Share Incentive Scheme shall be new A
Shares to be issued by our Company to the Participants. The Shares underlying the 2025
Restricted Share Incentive Scheme shall be A Shares purchased by our Company from the
secondarymarketand/ornewASharestobeissuedbyourCompanytotheParticipants.Each
grantedrestrictedSharerepresentstherighttopurchaseoneASharewithintheagreedperiod
atthegrantprice.TherelevantAShareswillbevestedintranchesuponthefulfillmentof the
stipulated vesting conditions. The maximum number of restricted Shares that can be granted
under the 2023 Restricted Share Incentive Scheme is 20,061,351 Shares and the maximum
number of restricted Shares that can be granted under the 2025 Restricted Share Incentive
Scheme is 62,088,500 Shares.
(v) Date of grant and term of the Scheme
The date on which the restricted Shares are granted shall be determined by the Board.
Thegrantof restrictedSharesforthefirsttimeshallbeapprovedbytheBoardandannounced
within 60 days after the approval of the Restricted Share Incentive Schemes by the
Shareholders’ meeting. The Restricted Share Incentive Schemes shall be effective from the
date of completion of the grant of restricted Shares under the Schemes up to the date when
therestrictedSharesgrantedundertheSchemesareallvestedorhavebeencanceled,provided
that the term of the Schemes shall not exceed 72 months.
(vi) Performance Targets and Vesting
Under the 2023 Restricted Share Incentive Scheme, subject to fulfillment of the
performance targets at Company level and Participant level, the restricted Shares held by the
Participants shall be vested in three installments of one-third each, commencing from 24
months, 36 months and 48 months, respectively, from date of the first grant of restricted
Shares to the grantee.
Under the 2025 Restricted Share Incentive Scheme, subject to fulfillment of the
performance targets at Company level and Participant level, the restricted Shares held by the
Participants shall be vested in three installments in the proportion of 33%, 33% and 34%,
commencing from 24 months, 36 months and 48 months, respectively, from date of the first
grant of restricted Shares to the grantee.
